title: eludite.editor editing operation input
description: An editing operation of brief 0068 on a document's selections (Edit > Advanced: indent, outdent, comment, uncomment, toggle comments, duplicate, delete line, line cut, open line, case, transpose, white space, expand and contract selection, the Clipboard Ring, cut, copy, paste, select all). Every selection takes part; the operation is one undo step.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
